w['late']=w.year>=1876; w['r']=w['count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL']/w.n_passages
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack(); return (g[True]-g[False]).mean()
print('est',est(w))
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
cells=[g.r.values for _,g in w.groupby(['genre','late'])]
bs=[]
for i in range(4000):
  m=[rng.choice(c,len(c)).mean() for c in cells]; bs.append(np.mean([m[2*k+1]-m[2*k] for k in range(8)]))
print('ci',np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]),np.mean(np.array(bs)<=0))
for nm,d in [('high',w[w.date_confidence=='high']),('nolow',w[w.date_confidence!='low']),('excl_other_coll',w[~w.genre.isin(['other','collection'])]),('1850-1900',w[(w.year>=1850)&(w.year<1900)]),('UK',w[w.origin=='UK']),('US',w[w.origin=='US'])]:
  print(nm,est(d))
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
f=smf.ols('r~late+C(genre)',w).fit(cov_type='cluster',cov_kwds={'groups':w.author_key.astype('category').cat.codes})
print(f.params['late[T.True]'],f.conf_int().loc['late[T.True]'].values)
pp=p[p.domains.apply(lambda x:'DISTANCE_TRAVEL' in list(x))]
print(len(pp)); print(pp.merge(w[['work_id','year','genre']],on='work_id').sort_values(['confidence','year'],ascending=False).head(8)[['passage_id','year','genre','technology_named']])
